verified_citations.citation: Section 15(4), Legal Metrology Act 2009, read with the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS) 2023
verified_citations.note: The real requirement behind the reason-to-believe gate: searches and seizures require reasons to believe recorded in writing beforehand.

Replaced Evidence Act s.65B on 2024-07-01. An electronic record needs a signed, timestamped certificate identifying the device, the production process, and the record's integrity to be certifiable -- not automatically court-proven.
